status: mechanism study, no new algorithm novelty established
X: Actual current observation, task, available knowledge, executable schemas and real receipts
D: Public decision proposal produced by the same policy, not a truth label at inference
exact_gradient: E_{D|X,A*}[grad log p_theta(D|X) + grad log p_theta(A*|X,D)]
condition: Sufficient differentiability and interchange of sum/gradient; finite check is exhaustive only for the constructed tables, not a proof of convergence for an LLM
joint_verified_event: For a fixed theta-independent C(X,D,A), sum_{D,A} p_theta(D|X)p_theta(A|X,D) C(X,D,A). A reference action is not the complete set of good 3D actions.
trajectory_endpoint: Ultimately evaluate actual final room under the original requirements after the policy follows its own states. One-step action likelihood does not establish this objective.
existing_loss: Inherited per-token family/component weights are a supervised design choice. They are not automatically a marginal-likelihood estimator or the unweighted joint log likelihood.

controls.S: Same D supervision, action given X
controls.P: Same D supervision, action given X and D where annotated; live D generated by the model
controls.additional: Same-knowledge frozen base, efficient direct-action deployment, ordinary rules/search; do not hide D generation or rejected actions in accounting

not_new: Latent-variable marginalization or generic posterior search
remaining_research_question: Whether spatially applicable design decisions improve complete-room requirements or total cost beyond these ordinary methods on independent projects.
